blurb: Ms. Patricia's offers recreational and competitive classes in dance, gymnastics, and cheer for ages 18 months and up. Classes include creative movement, ballet, tap, jazz, lyrical, acro, gymnastics skills, tumbling, and cheerleading. Private lessons and birthday parties are also available.
extraNote: Registration fee $25 for returning students, $30 for new students, due at registration · Payment accepted by cash, check, debit/credit card, and PayPal
